decisions.reason: As a bread variant close to the firm's core baking knowledge and production routines, it is easy to refine through internal learning, so despite limited later evidence the firm would likely retain it.
This sweet pastry fits the firm's established confectionery know-how and ingredient base, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to interpret demand and improve it rather than withdraw it.

The farmhouse bread is highly related to existing products and skills, so even with only short observed market history the firm would usually keep such an incremental extension unless sales were clearly weak.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen is a flagship seasonal product with a gold award and very strong overlap with the firm's traditional specialty knowledge, making continuation highly likely.

The premium Christmas stollen also received a gold award and builds directly on the firm's established seasonal expertise, so management would be inclined to keep it while monitoring overlap with other stollen lines.
